5. Cook the steak: Drizzle the steak with the grapeseed oil and season the steak on all 
sides with salt and pepper. Use a pair of metal tongs to gingerly place the steak on the

grains (or lines) in the meat. Taste for seasoning. Arrange it on its own platter.

asked for update from the horse's mouth, so family and 
insi er nends all get the response. 
2. All my thyroid removed this year, in two operations, one side at a 
time. If first side was benign, then don't remove second half. You can 
probably get by without medication on one side. Mine had ugly 
cancerous growth on first half, but not bad kind of cancer. 
3. Thyroid surgery does not necessarily remove all the thyroid 
tissue... there are always some fragments left. 
4. It is good to get rid of all of it, since fragments may contain 
cancerous tissues. 
5. Turns out, thyroid is the only tissue in the body that has an affinity 
for iodine. 
6. The endocrinologist plans the dose, and then you go to the 
hospital nuclear medicine department and take a radioactive iodine 
pill that comes in a lead box. 
7. You are in isolation for three days... can't be in the same room 
with anyone else. No sex. 
8. The radioactivity in the Iodine kills all the thyroid tissue in your 
body and there is never any more problem. 
9. Several friends have been through this, some many years ago. 
10. There are additional details in preparation, like salt free diet for 
week or so, but basically, that's the story. 
I I. I have schedule this for June, so it does not interfere with other 
activities.
